[perfect: nineja ninije ]

[future: nekṣyati nekṣyate nektā ]
verbal: niktá V.+ niktvā́ B.+ -níjya B.+ -níje 
secondary: passive: nijyate etc. E.+ -- intensive: nénekti nenikté etc. V.+ -- desiderative: ninikṣa- -- causative: nejayati etc. B.+ 
derivatives: -nij -nikti C. -neka S.C. -nega B.S. -neja C. nejaka C. -nejya PB. néjana V.+ -nektṛ S.
